original.name: div
original.statement: Type*} {b : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} (hb : ∀ i, IsUnit (m.leadingCoeff (b i))) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) : ∃ (g : ι →₀ (MvPolynomial σ R)) (r : MvPolynomial σ R), f = Finsupp.linearCombination _ b g + r ∧ (∀ i, m.degree (b i * (g i)) ≼[m] m.degree f) ∧ (∀ c ∈ r.support, ∀ i, ¬ (m.degree (b i) ≤ c))
